name: HORS liquidity contract approves a caller-supplied router for its LP tokens
summary: The unverified contract that seeded and held HORS's WBNB/HORS Cake-LP exposes a function (selector 0xf78283c7) that takes a token, a router and an LP token from any caller, approves the router for its token and LP balances and calls router.addLiquidity. The attacker passed its own contract as the router, whose addLiquidity pulled all 70.7m LP tokens, and removed the liquidity for 14.8 WBNB.
notes: The contract's only other call was the deployer's own 0xf78283c7 in May 2021, which added the liquidity it then held; its LP balance never moved until the anchor took all of it, so no earlier exploit exists. Loss is the WBNB the stolen LP redeemed; the HORS side is valued at nothing (rule 12).
